notes.title: Pinball M Patch - May 29 - 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello, horror pinball fans! 

Before next week’s Texas Chainsaw Massacre Pinball launch, we have released a ‘prepare-patch’ & update notes today. 

[h2]Here’s what’s changing in the game:[/h2]

 Unfortunately, Events will not be arriving into Pinball M. We apologize for the inconvenience, this feature will not be implemented. We hope you still enjoy the tables and tournaments!
All Leaderboards will be reset on June 6. Thanks to reports from our wonderful players, we have been able to fix multiple errors that affected scoring and fair competition in tables. Local leaderboards will not be reset.
- The maximum player profile level has been increased to level 120.- To prevent certain save game exploits, the game will only load the latest saved game from Classic and Arcade games. Trying to load anything but the last save will instead start a new game.
- Added a more extensive table filter and a new game mode filter for tournaments
- Arcade powerups that are not available on a table will be more clearly shown with a new graphic in the powerup selector.
- Added a new popup before the onboarding begins, which notifies players that the onboarding can be skipped. 
- The appearance of the default ball skin has been adjusted on all tables.
- All tables received performance optimizations.The rollout of the optimizations is the following: 	- Xbox and Playstation: All tables are updated today except System Shock, which will be updated with the June 6 release
	- PC: All tables are updated today
	- Nintendo Switch: All tables will be updated with the June 6 release. These updates should be most noticeable on this platform. 

[h2]Table fixes and changes arriving today:[/h2]

[b]Dead by Daylight Pinball:[/b]
- The ball save will no longer last for multiple minutes, as it did before in certain cases. 

[b]Chucky's Killer Pinball:[/b]
- The skill shot score has been significantly increased.
- The duration of the wizard mode bonus round, where every lane is lit for jackpots, has been reduced from 1 minute to 30 seconds.
- In all challenge modes, except for Shiver challenge, the table will award extra score correctly, not extra balls 

[b]The Thing Pinball:[/b]
- After having a ballout just after a tentacle was hit during the Man's Best Friend mode, the mode won't remain active for the next ball.
- The Impostor lock won't be chosen as the random award during the main modes of the table anymore
- Fixed an issue that could result in the ball getting stuck, after it has left the Rec Room mini playfield between the right side flippers.
- In all challenge modes, except for Shiver challenge, the table will award extra score correctly, not extra balls 

[b]Duke Nukem's Big Shot Pinball:[/b]
- Fixed the localization of the table's LCD display.
- In the campaign of Duke Nukem's Big Shot Pinball, the preview images for the reward of the "Damn... I'm looking good!" mission have been updated to accurately reflect the appearance of the Duke Nukem statue

[b][h2]General fixes[/h2][/b]

- The Rite of Passage achievement can once again be earned.
- The mini leaderboard for arcade mode will be visible now in the table play corners.
- After playing a daily challenge game, the post-game result screen and daily challenge screen in the main menu will correctly show the player's global daily rank on the vertical line, instead of the rank for the specific challenge played.
- In case a score for a tournament cannot be uploaded to the leaderboard at the post-game result screen due to connection issues, the game will reattempt uploading it each time it is launched, as it does for other game modes.
- In the tournament list and tournament table play corners Dread Challenge games will correctly show their type as Dread Challenge, instead of Survival Challenge.
- In tournament games with unlimited play attempts, the restart game option in the pause menu will now work correctly. The restart option is still disabled for tournaments with limited play attempts, to prevent accidentally wasted attempts.
- The sound notification for the last 5 seconds of game time in Shiver Challenges won't play constantly when the game mode is played without a time limit.
- When inspecting a player's profile, the table awards and powerup levels will correctly show what the given player has achieved.
- In the profile stats, the number of spotlighted tournaments created will be correctly tracked from now on.
- The options menu will correctly reopen after backing from the Personal Data menu.
- On the post-game result screen for tournaments, the spotlight progress bar won't go above 100%.
- Various minor onboarding fixes
- Activating the cabinet mode multiple times in a game session won't result in lower and lower frame rate at each activation anymore. Please note however, that using cabinet mode may still reduce frame rate by about 10-15%, depending on the exact hardware configuration and video settings, which is due to the additional viewports the game has to utilize.
- In cabinet mode, the LCD display for Duke Nukem's Big Shot Pinball is now correctly aligned vertically.
- The upscaler mode in the advanced graphics settings now has its options listed in ascending order and shows none when no upscaler method is selected.
- The progress for the current level of the Endless Tournament mastery won't reset when the player doesn't play Daily Challenges for a day.
- The voiceover associated with new community feed entries won't play when playing on a table. If the community feed finishes updating during gameplay, instead the voiceover will be delayed until the player exits to the main menu.
- The shield time in Survival Challenges won't expire earlier, based on how much time the player has waited before launching the ball.


[b][h2]Table fixes[/h2][/b]

[b]Wrath of the Elder Gods Director's Cut[/b]

- The Madness score multiplier will correctly reset when a mode is won with a ballout.
- The skillshot score and timer will correctly reset after the 5th skillshot, as stated in the table guide.
- Fixed an issue that resulted in 2 balls remaining in play, when the Maw multiball and Herald of its Word modes finished almost at the same time.
- During the wizard mode, the Herald cannot be beaten by one shot to its back.
- Fixed an issue that could result in the Herald keeping one ball indefinitely during multiball modes, when the Herald of its Word mode was also active.

[b]Dead by Daylight Pinball[/b]

- The volume of the "Sinkhole open!" voiceover has been reduced slightly.
- The "Sinkhole open!" voiceover won't play if the sinkhole is already open.
- The end-of-ball bonus multiplier will now be correctly applied.
- As a Survivor, after the second round of generator search hurry-up has finished, the lane of the previously repaired generators won't be blinking as if they can be repaired again.
- As a Killer, after a ballout, the blinking lights at lanes and ramps will still correctly show if the given target has been shot once already.
- As a Killer, after a ballout during a survivor chase or hook phase, the trap will always reappear correctly.

[b]Chucky's Killer Pinball
[/b]
- Fixed a crash that could occur at the end of the Olly Olly Oxen Free mode.
- When the marble jar is hit with the razor flipper, the razor flipper will now correctly remain active during the Marbles multiball mode.
- The ball cannot fall inside the slingshots anymore in some rare cases.


[b]The Thing Pinball[/b]

- When the Man's Best Friend mode ends with a tentacle droptarget remaining and the table is restarted, the collision of the last tentacle won't remain active, preventing one of the lanes from being shot.
- The Who Goes There? mode being lost won't cause one of the Wizard mode target lanes to be inactive, preventing the Wizard mode from being completed.
- The next Husky target should always correctly appear now during the Lockdown mode.
- Finishing the Fire Frenzy mode with a ballout or by the game ending won't result in the mode being won.
- When multiple extra balls are unlocked, each shot to the sinkhole will award them correctly.
- The table's display will always show the correct award when the random award is collected.
- When the random award sinkhole is active, the lights of the BOOZE rollovers won't turn off after a ballout.
- Tilting the table is now possible in Dread Challenges as well.
- After tilting, the table won't remain in a tilted state with the following balls in these game modes either: Distance Challenge, Rescue Challenge, Survival Challenge

[b]Duke Nukem's Big Shot Pinball[/b]

- The ball physics at the skillshot has been adjusted, to make the ball's speed frame rate independent, as it is shot from the lift.
- Reduced the chance for straight down the middle ballouts when hitting the targets for the We're Gonna Fry Your Ass mode.
- Trying to start the Cinema mode while the two sides of the bridge are already raised for the Ready For Action multiball lock won't cause the table to lock up.
- The end-of-ball multiplier won't be kept after a tilt.
- After continuing a previously saved game, the displays showing the two dancers won't appear in an incorrect orientation.
- Duke won't sit back down during gameplay when the table intro is skipped very quickly.
- The extra ball that is earned for 2 minutes of multiball and a following super jackpot will now be earned as soon as the super jackpot has been hit, instead of at the end of the multiball mode. The table guide has also been updated to include the super jackpot requirement for this extra ball.
- Duke won't change between incorrect animations, when the Ready for Action multiball's super jackpot and the Eat Shit and Die! mode's targets are shot after each other.

notes.title: Pinball M - Patch Notes (V. 1.0.2)
notes.content:
Hi Pinball M fans!

Pinball M players - a first patch arrived with multiple fixes, features, and tweaks. Many of them you have reported since last week's launch - thank you for putting in the word to fix these.

[h2]New features:[/h2]

- (PC only) The cabinet mode has received ingame configuration options.

- (PC only) It is now possible start a specific table and game mode with command line parameters passed to the game's executable.

- When exiting a table, the game now checks whether a new profile level has been reached and will display the level up screen when appropriate.

- When playing Hotseat, the Leaderboard button in the pause menu will now display the Local Classic Leaderboard.


[h2]Balance changes:[/h2]

- Predefined local high score values have been polished for all tables.

- In Campaign, target values of the second and third skull targets on each table has been fine tuned.

- In Daily Challenges, the score to challenge points conversion rate has been adjusted for all tables.

- The time requirement for reaching all levels of the Going Postal mastery for Duke Nukem's Big Shot Pinball table has been reduced.

- The time requirement for reaching all levels of the I Like To Play mastery for Chucky's Killer Pinball table has been reduced.

- The rune lamp requirement for reaching all levels of the Decipher the Runes mastery for the Wrath of the Elder Gods table has been increased.

- The story mode requirement for reaching all levels of the Fear, Paranoia and Mistrust mastery for the Thing Pinball table has been modified.

- The duration of the "Slow Motion" powerup has been increased on all powerup levels.

- The duration of the "Score Boost" powerup has been decreased to higher powerup levels.

- Leveling progression of the "Combo Time Bonus" has been accelerated.

- Leveling progression of the following powerups have been slowed down:

Distance Bonus

Multiball Score Bonus

Ball Save Time Bonus

Skillshot Score Bonus

Slow Motion

[h2]General fixes:[/h2]

- Purchased DLC tables should now remain fully accessible while being offline.

- Duke Nukem's Big Shot Pinball table achievement descriptions have been updated to show the correct requirements.

- Network communication has been optimized, which should result in faster leaderboard, tournament list, and community feed load times. In some cases, this should also eliminate stuttering framerate.

- Fixed an issue that caused masteries to retain most of the progress from the previous level after they had leveled up.

- Changed the description of the Endless Tournament mastery, to clarify that it gains progress only once per day.

- Fixed the time calculation for the Going Postal mastery of Duke Nukem's Big Shot Pinball table.

- Fixed the unresponsive Leaderboard and Continue buttons on the Daily Challenge result screen.

- Fixed an issue that could cause the Overall Daily Challenge leaderboard to appear empty and the Daily Ranking to not work.

- Fixed the new item notifications on the Vault and Player Profile. They should now disappear when there are no unseen new items left.

- The banner foreground customization items for the Dead by Daylight Pinball table will now show the correct images on player banners.

- Fixed the typo in the score requirement for the 3rd skull target in the 7th campaign mission of The Thing Pinball table.

- The Current Daily Challenge Rank stat in the Player Profile will diplay None, instead of -1 when a player doesn't have a rank yet.

- Fixed the issue where the incorrect level of mastery icons were displayed when inspecting players.

- Fixed the incorrect logic behind the displayed personal best time for Rescue Challenge type of campaign missions. Now these should show the lowest results.

- Fixed the typo in the score requirement for the 3rd skull target in the 7th campaign mission of the The Thing Pinball table.

- Fixed typos in onboarding messages.

- Fixed the missing space in the description of the Swift Escape mastery for the Dead by Daylight Pinball table.

- Fixed the typo in the name of the Harbinger title.

- When exiting a table, the game now checks whether a new profile level has been reached and will display the level-up screen when appropriate.

Table fixes:

- The ball should not get stuck anymore on invisible objects on the various lanes of The Thing Pinball table.

- The Thing Pinball table will stay dark in Shiver Challenge, when the Man's Best Friend or the Blackout mode is active.

- Adjusted ball behavior on the left orbit of The Thing Pinball table, to prevent straight down the middle ballouts.

- When they finish, all modes of The Thing Pinball table will now reset the ball skin back to the one equipped, instead of the default skin.

- The Trap Season table award on the Dead by Daylight Pinball table will now unlock even when using the Double Hit perk as the Killer.

- The "Time's Up!" VO won't keep repeating on the Dead by Daylight Pinball table, when the player doesn't hook a Survivor in time.

- Fixed the visibility of the marble balls on the Chucky's Killer Pinball table during Shiver Challenge.

- The spider-like creature will only appear above the right orbit on the Wrath of the Elder Gods table, when the Rune Awards are available.
- Fixed the German localization of the LCD display on the Dead by Daylight Pinball table.

[h2]PC-specific fixes:[/h2]
Game fixes:

- The Achievement system should be functional now in the Epic Games Store version of the game.

- The Steam version of the game should now correctly save whether cabinet mode has been enabled and all of its settings. Due to technical reasons, in the Epic Games Store version of the game the cabinet mode still has to be reactivated after each game launch, but otherwise its settings will be saved.

- Enabling cabinet mode won't disable the Daily Challenge and Tournaments main menu tabs.

notes.title: Pinball M launches on Thursday! - Cabinet Mode
notes.content:
Dear Pinball Fans,

We have seen multiple requests and questions about the availability of cabinet mode in Pinball M over the last week. We are happy to say, that [b]cabinet mode will be available in the game from Day 1[/b]! This mode will be similar to the one we had in the earlier iterations of Pinball FX, so you might be familiar with it. Let’s see some details!

[h3]How do I activate cabinet mode? [/h3]

Open the game and then navigate to Settings. Click on ‘Cabinet Mode’ and the game will switch over. You can deactivate it the same way. 

[h3]How much will it cost to access Cabinet Mode?[/h3]

Just like in Pinball FX, cabinet mode will be free in Pinball M!

[h3]Do I need to be online for Cabinet Mode? [/h3]

In Pinball M, if you activate the mode in-game, offline play is supported. 

[h3]How can I place the DMD and the Backglass where desired? [/h3]

Activate Cabinet Mode in the Settings menu. 
This will create the Cabinet folder in your game directory. You can reach it by going into:
Steam - steamapps - common - Pinball M -  PinballM - Mods - Cabinet

You will find a couple of options to customize here:

[b]Settings.ini [/b]file - This is the file you’ll need to set the parameters in. The process is very similar to Pinball FX3. 

[b]Backglass images:[/b] 
There are 2 image types. One, which you need to name pfx.png will serve as the default background of your backglass. 

The other type is table-specific images. Each table has a number, and you’ll need to copy your desired backglass images of each table into this directory. Name them according to the table number, for example: ‘Table_147’ for Wrath of the Elder Gods - Director’s Cut. 

Please find a list of Table numbers at the end of this section. 

[h3]How will Cabinet Mode be supported? [/h3]

The features released at launch are the foundation of the mode. We are planning to improve this mode with future updates.

[h3]Will Pincab Mode be supported for all tables?
[/h3]
Yes, once unlocked Pincab Mode is available for every table in Pinball M.
We can’t wait to show you our brand new “M” rated pinball game, this is a dream coming true for us to launch a new platform without any limitations. Don’t forget to [b]wishlist[/b] the game, as Pinball M launches on Thursday! ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337640?utm_source=steamnews


And finally, here are the table IDs for the images:

Duke Nukem's Big Shot Pinball  176
Dead by Daylight™ Pinball  174
The Thing Pinball  175
[i]Chucky's Killer Pinball [/i] 171
Wrath of the Elder Gods - Director’s Cut  147

Linne

Navigate through an eerie playfield where Chucky lurks in the shadows, ready to pounce. Okay sport, are you ready to play a game of “Chucky Says”?!

We will also release an updated version of [b]Wrath of the Elder Gods[/b], [b]which will come as a free download with the game![/b] Get ready for the unrestricted eldritch horror.

And there is more!! We will reveal other terrifying creations as we get closer to release. Are you ready to be terrified?


(Just kidding, you can't be ready)

notes.title: Embark on a horrifying journey in Pinball M!
notes.content:
Hey Pinball Fans,

You are probably wondering what is Pinball M about?! Now here is the first news about our new horrifying pinball game!

[b]What does “M” stand for?
[/b]
The adventures in Pinball M are only for ‘M’ature audiences as the designers unleashed hell on the tables. Swearing, blood in every amount possible along with terrifying creatures will haunt the players while they hunt those desired top scores on the leaderboards. Strap in, as it won’t be an easy ride!

[b]Wrath of the Elder Gods in Pinball M[/b]

You have probably seen in-game screenshots of “Warth of the Elder Gods” on our store page. We would like to highlight, that you won’t have to buy the table again, in fact, [b]the table will be available for free[/b] in the game with upgrades! We will level up the horrors on the table to make it something you haven’t seen in your worst nightmares!

[b]What is the release date of Pinball M?[/b]

We are glad to tell you, that you won’t have to wait much more to find out when the game of your nightmares hits the store. ;)

[b]Will Pinball M feature brand-new tables?[/b]

Yes! We are waiting for guesses and ideas in the comment section. ;)

We can’t wait to share more details with you about the pinball game from hell. Be aware that this ball might be covered with more red than silver.
